sections: Global authority lock order and retained observations

repo_truth: Bootstrap registry authority, CTAP codecs, append-only lineage, candidate persistence, and promotion transactions are present in the shared worktree. This lane owns a new approval/use-chain module and focused tests only.
allowed_scope: Add crates/engine/src/charter_approval_workflow.rs and focused hcm_2_2 approval/use tests.
Consume committed-registry observation, CTAP verification, and lineage APIs without editing their owning files.
Coordinate additive lib.rs exports with the parent; do not edit compiler/CLI/flow/docs.
non_goals: Do not implement registry add/revoke/update or lifecycle/promotion builders.
Do not accept caller ceremony records, identities, fingerprints, files, stdin, software signatures, or weaker authority.
Do not commit or write handoffs/ledger/proof/control.
tasks: Implement caller-intent-only Charter approval request/result types.
Re-read committed candidate and registry pair, build exact randomized JCS challenge, select eligible credential, call opaque GetAssertion, decode and verify ES256 against committed key.
Persist decoded response, assertion, use transition/head, and approval through one recoverable authority transaction with replay/sign-count/sequence/waiver/basis checks.
Test frozen approval transcripts, stale/forged/replay/wrong-pair/no-eligible/unsafe-platform/port-unavailable/all-null refusal, and exact sequence rules.
contracts_and_gates: Locks/recovery precede randomness and native calls.
No semantic record or changed path is published before one commit point.
Approval authority pair is re-derived from current committed registry and candidate requirements.
Use-head authority is shared, bounded, replay-safe, and exact.
stop_conditions: Stop before HIGH/CRITICAL existing-symbol edits and report blast radius.
Return blocked rather than weaken native authority or cross into another lane.
